attchmntText: ABB India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Expanding demand across segments; solid execution".
voiceSummary: ABB India Limited issued a press release on November 13, 2026, regarding its third quarter results for calendar year 2026. The company reported record orders of INR 4,733 crore, a 56% year-on-year increase. The order backlog stood at INR 12,927 crore, up 36% year-on-year. Revenue for the quarter was INR 3,738 crore, reflecting a 19% year-on-year growth. Operational EBITA increased by 15% to INR 484 crore. Profit after tax rose by 10% to INR 440 crore. Earnings per share were reported at INR 20.76. The company highlighted strong demand across electrification, motion, and automation segments, driven by investments in data centers, grid modernization, and renewable energy.

attchmntText: ABB India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr. N V Sivakumar as Independent Director of the company w.e.f. January 01, 2027.
voiceSummary: ABB India Limited Board of Directors approved the proposal to appoint Mr. N. V. Sivakumar, DIN 03534101, as an Independent Director for a term of three years effective January 1, 2027. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval. The Board also approved the Postal Ballot Notice to seek this approval. Mr. Sivakumar is not related to any Board member and meets Independent Director criteria. He is not debarred by SEBI. The Postal Ballot Notice will be filed with stock exchanges and sent to shareholders separately.

attchmntText: ABB India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: ABB India Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, approved by the Board on November 13, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 3,738.13 crores, compared to 3,130.11 crores in the corresponding period of 2025. Profit for the period stood at 442.52 crores, up from 409.04 crores in the prior year quarter. Year-to-date revenue for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, was 10,481.06 crores, with a total profit of 2,588.47 crores. The company recorded a profit of 1,685.47 crores from discontinued operations, primarily due to the sale of its Robotics business. Earnings per share for continuing operations was 20.76. The results were reviewed by M/s B S R & Co. LLP.
